name: Lab 89 -- Regular Expression Denial of Service: a signup username check uses a redundant nested quantifier, so one near-miss request costs the server seconds of CPU on its own.
notes: Local lab on port 5089. Copy this preset to project.json in a fresh directory, then launch NullockApp --project=<absolute-directory>. Start the lab separately with python app.py. Advanced scope restricts traffic to localhost or 127.0.0.1 on this port.
